test a robust weighted combo on the full pool using softmax_neg_error to see if it beats the current weighted pool4 result.
The series has unstable ranking and a strong trend; a robust non‑linear aggregation like median over the full pool may improve robustness.
test a robust weighted combo on the full pool using inverse_error to see if it beats the current median.
The series is trend-dominated with unstable ranking; a robust DBA on the full pool may outperform median.
The series has unstable ranking and a strong trend; a forward greedy weighting may capture complementary models better than simple mean or median.
The series has unstable ranking and weak seasonality; a trimmed mean on the full pool may provide robustness by discarding extreme outliers.
The series has unstable ranking and weak seasonality; a robust weighted combo on a smaller, more stable pool (pool4) may improve over median.
robust median on a stable subset
The series is trend-dominated with unstable ranking; a per-horizon best-model weighting could capture horizon shifts while staying robust.
The series is trend‑dominated with unstable ranking; a simple mean over a stable subset may outperform the median.

decision.justification: Selected 'median on pool4' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.5923. Series context: trend strength 0.6208 and seasonal strength 0.0469; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.08); 10 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 4.169.
